defects.description: Middle-name mismatch: application form 'Wonthong Yeptho' vs identity document 'Wonthong T. Yeptho'.
Date-of-birth mismatch between application form and identity document.
Income certificate expired before the submission date.

Application form has no detected signature.
Transcript CGPA (5.4) is below the required minimum (6.0).

Bank statement account holder ('W. Yeptho') does not match applicant name ('Wonthong Yeptho').
Identity document uploaded as an unsupported file type (image/heic).
Expected escalation for the unresolvable conditional Category Certificate requirement.
